['Unitymedia GmbH '].company_description: Vodafone GmbH is a mobile telecommunications operator in Germany providing mobile phone, LTE, 5G, cable internet, landlines, cable TV, and IPTV services. It has more than 31 million mobile customers in Germany and serves both prepaid and postpaid customers on GSM and LTE. Vodafone Germany's main competitors are Telekom Deutschland and Telefónica Germany.

['RheinEnergie AG '].company_description: RheinEnergie AG is a local energy company that holds the naming rights to the RheinEnergieStadion in Cologne. It is also a subsidiary of Stadtwerke Köln GmbH, which undertakes water supply and electrical, gas, heat, and steam energy supply, waste management, housing services, and operates public baths in the city of Cologne.
